_note: JLCPCB fab-capability rules, versioned DATA per docs/backlog/pcb-guided-place-route.md 'Export + order' — two tiers per row (jlc_min = JLC's published process minimum, house_default = our margin above it) so a DRC digest can quote spent headroom instead of hiding a constant. 'source'/'retrieved' are per-row because these are third-party numbers that change. field_confidence carries, per field, the number's provenance and any caveat needed to use it safely — 'high'/'medium' were checked directly against a live JLCPCB page on 2026-08-27 (see 'source'); 'low'/'n/a' mark figures JLC does not publish for that process, where the value is deliberately null rather than an invented number. house_default margin rule (auditable, applied uniformly): house_default = max(1.5 x jlc_min, rounded up to the nearest 0.05mm; JLC's own published 'recommended' figure, where one exists) — except soldermask_dam_mm, whose house_default is set above the 2oz-copper figure (0.20mm) rather than the 1oz jlc_min, so a copper-weight change on the order doesn't silently violate it; and except via_diameter_mm (2026-08-28), which this flat rule must NOT be applied to at all — see its own paragraph below. board_edge_clearance is two figures, not one (routed-edge vs V-cut-edge minimums differ and neither is conservative for the other); when the panelization method isn't known yet, use the V-cut (board_edge_clearance_vcut_mm) figure as the safe default. npth_annular_ring_mm is JLC's non-plated-hole copper-clearance requirement (0.2mm of copper must be cleared around an NPTH for the sealing film) — previously misfiled as via_diameter_mm's 0.45mm figure; it is now its own field. It is NOT coupled to any other field this table stores (the NPTH hole diameter it's measured against is a per-design value, never a capability constant), unlike via_diameter_mm below. via_diameter_mm (2026-08-28 fix, gr-shaped defect: every default-sized via failed annular-ring DRC): diameter, drill and annular ring are geometrically coupled (diameter >= drill + 2 x annular_ring) — margining each of the three SEPARATELY under the flat 1.5x rule silently produced a house_default via whose ring (0.075mm) undercut even jlc_min's own ring (0.18mm). The value stored here for via_diameter_mm is JLC's published absolute-minimum finished-via-diameter FLOOR only (a real, independent, per-tier-identical constraint) — precis.pcb.capabilities.load_capabilities() derives the EFFECTIVE per-tier value as max(that floor, drill_mm + 2 x annular_ring_mm) at the SAME tier, so the geometry wins whenever it asks for more than the floor (which it does, at both tiers, once the ring is a real ring). Never read via_diameter_mm out of this raw file directly for that reason; go through load_capabilities(). Sources checked 2026-08-27: https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities (primary FR-4 capability table); https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/jlc-aluminum-substrates-are-now-available (aluminum, page states 'last updated Aug 13, 2025'); https://jlcpcb.com/news/new-arrival-aluminum-pcb-boards (aluminum, published 2022-10-13).

field_confidence.trace_width_mm: high — verified against jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities 2026-08-27: 1oz-copper 2-layer minimum trace width is 0.10mm
field_confidence.trace_spacing_mm: high — same page/date; 2-layer minimum trace spacing is 0.10mm
field_confidence.annular_ring_mm: high — page states an absolute minimum of 0.18mm with a recommended value of 0.25mm; jlc_min is the absolute figure, house_default clears the recommended one
field_confidence.drill_mm: high — 0.15mm mechanical-drill minimum confirmed; the page separately notes 0.20mm as the preferred minimum for a plated through-hole via, which house_default also clears
field_confidence.via_diameter_mm: high — 0.25mm is JLC's published minimum finished via diameter, stored here as a FLOOR only (2026-08-28: this field is DERIVED, see this file's _note and capabilities.py's module docstring). It is the SAME floor at both tiers — diameter/drill/annular_ring are geometrically coupled, so house_default's real margin comes from drill_mm and annular_ring_mm's own margins, not from re-margining this field a third independent time (that was the 2026-08-27 defect: the flat 1.5x rule applied here alone produced a house_default via whose ring undercut jlc_min's own ring)
field_confidence.npth_annular_ring_mm: high — JLC requires 0.2mm-ish of copper cleared around a non-plated hole for the sealing film; this table stores the resulting 0.45mm figure as a RADIAL clearance (parallel to annular_ring_mm's own convention — checked directly against the measured hole-edge-to-copper-edge gap, never against a hole diameter). Not coupled to any other field this table stores (2026-08-28 audit): the hole diameter it is measured against is a per-design value, never a capability constant, unlike via_diameter_mm's drill/ring coupling. Formerly misfiled under via_diameter_mm
field_confidence.board_edge_clearance_vcut_mm: high — V-cut-edge copper-to-edge minimum is 0.40mm, double the routed-edge figure; use this one as the conservative default when the panelization method is unknown
field_confidence.soldermask_dam_mm: high — 0.10mm minimum solder-mask dam applies at 1oz copper (this row's default weight); at 2oz copper the minimum is 0.20mm. jlc_min carries the 1oz figure; house_default (0.25mm) is set above the 2oz figure so a copper-weight change doesn't silently violate it
field_confidence.silk_width_mm: high — minimum silkscreen line width is 0.15mm (minimum text height is 1.0mm, tracked separately as it isn't one of this table's fields)

field_confidence.trace_width_mm: high — verified 2026-08-27: JLC publishes one multilayer trace-width/spacing figure (0.09mm) that covers all layers of the stack — confirmed there is no separate inner-layer minimum, resolving the earlier 'may differ, not verified' open question. Caveat: inner copper is 0.5oz by default; if the order specifies 2oz inner copper, the multilayer minimum becomes 0.15mm (this row assumes the 0.5oz default and does not model the 2oz-inner case)
field_confidence.trace_spacing_mm: high — see trace_width_mm note; same 0.09mm figure and same 2oz-inner-copper caveat
field_confidence.annular_ring_mm: high — page states an absolute minimum of 0.15mm with a recommended value of 0.20mm; jlc_min is the absolute figure, house_default clears the recommended one
field_confidence.drill_mm: high — same mechanical-drill process/minimum as the 2-layer row (0.15mm)
field_confidence.via_diameter_mm: high — same published 0.25mm floor as the 2-layer row, same DERIVED field (2026-08-28: see this file's _note and capabilities.py's module docstring) — not independently re-margined at house_default
field_confidence.npth_annular_ring_mm: high — same NPTH copper-clearance requirement as the 2-layer row (a radial figure, not coupled to any other field this table stores; see the 2-layer row's own note)
field_confidence.board_edge_clearance_routed_mm: high — same routed-edge figure as the 2-layer row (0.20mm); JLC's page does not vary this by layer count
field_confidence.board_edge_clearance_vcut_mm: high — same V-cut figure as the 2-layer row (0.40mm); use as the conservative default when panelization is unknown
field_confidence.soldermask_dam_mm: high — same 1oz/2oz split as the 2-layer row (0.10mm at 1oz, 0.20mm at 2oz); jlc_min assumes 1oz outer copper, house_default (0.25mm) clears the 2oz figure
field_confidence.silk_width_mm: high — same 0.15mm minimum silkscreen line width as the 2-layer row

rows.label: Aluminum (metal-core, single-layer)
rows.process_notes: Single-sided metal-core only: no plated vias and JLC explicitly advises against through-hole parts on this process (via_diameter_mm is null by construction, not a missing figure). Board shaping is CNC-milled and requires a minimum 1.6mm milling cutter, so slots and panel/board gaps must be >= 1.6mm. Available thickness: 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 / 1.6mm, at 1oz copper. Surface finish is HASL only (no ENIG). Soldermask color is white or black only.

field_confidence.trace_width_mm: high — verified 2026-08-27 against JLC's aluminum-substrate pages: minimum trace width is 0.10mm (corrected down from the previous 0.15mm, which overstated the minimum)
field_confidence.trace_spacing_mm: high — same pages; minimum trace spacing is 0.10mm
field_confidence.annular_ring_mm: low — JLC publishes no annular-ring figure for aluminum boards; null is deliberate (not carried over from the FR-4 rows, which do not necessarily apply), not a missing number
field_confidence.drill_mm: high — CRITICAL CORRECTION 2026-08-27: minimum drill diameter on aluminum is 0.65mm. The previous jlc_min (0.30mm) and house_default (0.35mm) were both below this real minimum — a house default that was itself unmanufacturable. 0.30mm appears to have been the 1-layer FR-4 drill figure mistakenly transplanted onto this row

field_confidence.npth_annular_ring_mm: low — JLC publishes no NPTH copper-clearance figure for aluminum boards; null is deliberate, not carried over from the FR-4 rows
